AT0102.title: Robot Hardware Debug Interface Exploitation Tool
keywords: robot hardware debug interface exploitation tool
AT0102.description: An exploitation toolset targeting robot BLE provisioning interfaces, debug serial ports, JTAG/UART maintenance ports, and vendor-SDK hardcoded credentials. The tool integrates BLE provisioning command injection (Unitree UniPwn-style, using the hardcoded AES key to bypass authentication by encrypting the string "unitree" and then calling system() via a malicious Wi-Fi SSID for root), hardcoded-credential scanning, debug-serial root-shell acquisition, and JTAG interface probing, enabling near-field or physical-contact attacks on robots like Unitree Go1/Go2/G1/H1 and Universal Robots UR series. It draws on research such as UniPwn (CVE-2025-35027), the CloudSail backdoor (CVE-2025-2894), the Alias Robotics Unitree G1 assessment, and IOActive UR vulnerabilities. Unlike AT0081 (IoT firmware & device exploitation tool) which focuses on general IoT firmware, this tool focuses on robot debug/provisioning interfaces and vendor SDKs.
